Don't run prayers that reduce health, accuracy or defense in the Dog Den; the big beefy prayer hinders progress.
Cavern 4 monument bonuses that are bucket fill rate multiply it, almost 16x for him; even a few levels help a lot.
Higher mining efficiency and AFK gains from outside the hole make layers easier; he now needs four or five days per layer.
Base attack amplifier goes to level 100 where dogs deal 418 trillion more damage and mobs one-shot you.
Level 100 is impossible for him to survive, but if you kill fast enough you may manage; early dogs give few points, later waves more.
The atom collider gets a new use: he spent 4.5 billion atoms to reach level 156 on ring per hour; the sixth improvement isn't in the game yet.
Improvement stacking: every 25 levels across the six improvement methods gives 10% to all others; he has 19.2x.
Nothing yet speeds up renewing; it stays a flat 25 hours even with these bonuses.
RNG Oxidizing Layer: a failed clean multiplies the next success chance by 25%, e.g. 12% becomes 15%, not adds 25%.
Start Conjurer upgrades in the blue section: blue one two and three for villager XP
Reset opals after unlocking Cavern 9 or 10 and invest them in engineer to level 20-25 and measurer to 10-12
Aim for well over 130k exp/hour; one player with 100+ Opals in engineer gets about 1M exp/hour.
Once at about 20/20 on the top two villagers
Clicking the bonfire lets you interact with villagers and spend hole resources for bonuses inside and outside the hole.
Explorer is the first villager unlocked at the hole surface; he treks the caverns and unlocks new zones for resources.
Ten caverns currently available: five shallow caverns and five Glow Room tunnels.
Engineer unlocks bonuses for progress in the hole and some bonuses outside the hole.
Purple background bonuses affect the hole directly; blue schematics affect things outside; the opal one is an exception spent outside.
Conjurer is the third villager unlocked in Cavern 5 and has three bonus categories.
Hole magic affects the hole; village magic affects the surface (villager exp); idolon magic affects things outside the hole.
Measurer is the fourth villager and is unlocked in Cavern 7.
Measurer gets a new bonus each level; upgrading a bonus needs a hole resource such as mithal ore from Cavern 1.
Opals are gained inside the hole from various activities.
Opal enthusiasm: every 10th opal boosts experience 150%; needs five points invested to reach full 150%.
Explorer unlocks 10 caves now; the 10th cave has no bonuses yet but should in a future update.
Engineer unlocks three schematics per level plus one extra every five levels; one level gives only two.
Hole magic monument bonus for Cavern 4 takes four points total and doubles all monument bonuses.
Measurer bonuses are among the most significant in the hole; each needs one cavern resource and an outside multiplier.
Cavern 5 bell ringing can randomly give a bucket fill rate bonus; his is about a 7x multiplier (7140%).
Level 100 needs 101 Q accuracy for 100% hit chance; he has 27 trillion so can reach about level 65-70, and may need more accuracy points.
The measurer bonus for bell ring and ping rate is upgraded with caltine ore, a very big deal.
Bell ring and ping rate is multiplied by death note points: 10 points for 100 million kills and 20 for each eclipse skull, per world.
Cavern 6 (the harp) is the first Glow Room tunnels cavern and is a resource generation cavern similar to the well and Cavern 1
Harp main purposes: unlock engineer schematics and upgrade measurer bonuses and the harp itself
Harp power starts at 5% every 1.5 minutes giving 100% every 30 minutes
Opals are found using the D string; total Opals found is displayed on the right
Each strummed string generates notes if proper string selected and gives experience to the string selected which levels its bonuses
C string generates an amount of the note you are tuned to and its level bonus gives harp note gain percentage
Notes per strum equal harp power times bonuses and are per string not total
D string gives a small chance at an opal per strum multiplied by harp power; opals very hard to get at start
F string generates about a quarter of C's notes but also gives the adjacent two notes so three types at 3/4 total potential
F string level bonus is harp note gain so balance it out
G string level bonus multiplies string EXP and works even when tuned to another note
Loaded harp engineer bonus adds a string going from three to four strings for about 30% more gains
With seven strings the domino effect multiplier on the last string is 140%
Engineer unlocks F string and G string which makes leveling the rest of your strings easier
Measurer harp note gain bonus requires notes and multiplies with slab; author level 86 gives 132%
Harp is back and forth between leveling measurer and harp with notes; G string leveling also gives harp gain
Bell bonus also gives harp note gain when leveled up
Cavern 7 lamp is daily resource generation based on wishes from measurer conjurer and wish system
Initially you have one wish that gives more wishes; each wish unlock costs more than the last
Another try wish resets all opals invested letting you reinvest them in villagers for experience per hour more efficiently
Author generates 4.86 wishes a day; base is one wish a day; leveling measurer and Bell increases it
Bring them back wish grants 12 hours of AFK time to the Bravery Monument for two wishes
Hole magic gives up to 90% additional wishes at lamp every day
Bell also generates small daily lamp wishes; author gets almost five wishes per day
Cavern 8 hive is like motherload but catching; use archer-based classes to catch flies to unlock hive layers
Hive needs catching efficiency; first five or ten layers easy then much harder as layers need more bugs and efficiency
Each destroyed hive layer gives one opal
Cavern 9 Grotto is last cavern with content; Cavern 10 is unlockable but has nothing yet
Mob respawn from bubonic conjurer or divine knight doesn't work in Grotto but siege breaker's pirate flag does
Kill enough mushrooms in layers to challenge the Monarch; each Monarch kill gives an opal
Mushrooms have a chance at dropping the new Dragon Warrior statue at very low drop rate
Boss HP and mushrooms needed rise per layer but gloomy mushroom HP does not change so don't fear new layers
The Well (cavern 1) is resource generation and management; 10 rocks total, starting with gravel and one bucket.
More unlocked rocks means more expansions and so a higher fill-rate multiplier; buckets can all be the same or different rocks.
Some bonuses give skill efficiency and exp based on motherload layers destroyed which helps destroy more layers; the fractal fly in cavern 8 gives similar skill efficiency.
Unattacked hounds generate fear (skull bar) and a full bar ends the run; you must kill them quickly and not get one-shot.
Cavern 4 Monument of Bravery is an AFK mechanic; every 20 hours you play 'tell me a story', a text-based wave fight, for bonuses.
Each opal obtained from the monument halves the chance of the next; he has only six, and each killed monster gives a bonus.
Bonuses include bucket fill rate, mining efficiency, cooking speed, villager exp, gaming bits, damage and Bell ping rate; higher waves unlock rarer bonuses.
AFK hours at the monument unlock bonuses on the left side, from 20 to 100, 300, 750 up to 24,000 total hours.
Waiting beyond 20 hours stacks a reward multiplier (currently 1.6, +60% to bonuses), but opals are never multiplied.
Engineer bonus 'story changes over time': bravery swords get +1 minimum and +10 maximum damage per AFK hour at the monument.
First Try I Swear: throwing the last sword first and one-shotting the mob gives a damage bonus, but if you don't one-shot it you lose it.
Reroll Keeper: rerolling a sword throw resets mob HP so you can rethrow for a higher roll; not using rerolls gives a damage multiplier.
Each unused reroll gives 10% damage, so using none gives 50%; his swords deal 272 to 57,000 before bonuses.
Further bonuses give two extra swords, rethrow up to five swords per day, and one more sword; base is three swords and he has six.
The only way to keep bonuses is to run away; swords need not be used in order, and the Last Sword gives a bonus.
One-shotting with the last sword gave a 10% damage buff; he prioritizes bucket fill rate when choosing a bonus for clearing a round.
Upgrading the measurer raises the sword's maximum damage; bucket fill rate is a higher priority than village exp.
He spends a rethrow when a roll is too low (9,000) since he needs at least 40,000 to do 200,000 total.
Cavern 5 Bell has four sections plus engineer and measurer bonuses; ringing the bell generates bell power hourly to spend.
Each ring gives a random level in bucket fill rate, harp note gains (cavern 6), villager exp or daily lamp wishes (cavern 7); engineer bonuses give multiple levels.
Pinging the Bell is the opal mechanic; ring, ping and clean are separate resources and you pick one to generate at a time.
Second improvement, bell clean per hour, is levelled with mithril ore; the third, more ring per hour, uses gaming bits and multiplies with the first.
Fourth improvement raises bell ping per hour using harp notes; the fifth raises ring per hour based on atoms.
Renewing the Bell costs 25 hours of bell power and resets the bottom bonuses, keeping improvements and opals.
Each measurer bonus is multiplied by an outside stat; villager exp base 45% times 3.27 from Toma score gives 150%.
Each villager has its own invested Opals; you choose the split; his were 21 measurer
String is Strung unlocks five extra harp strings in Cavern 6 for five points; may be worth delaying if you bought gem shop Opals.
Wishy Washy gives up to 90% chance of an extra daily wish
Contented Creator gives village exp per schematic you have bought
Pocket Divinity gives 15% all stat for him (30% with a second point) and is great without Companion King Doot.
Without King Doot
Big Forge multiplies forge capacity
Big Forge multiplies capacity 3x per point (3
Resource bursting raises max multi-resource chance (ore

Weapon Relevancy raises weapon power's effect on damage by 75% per point
Measurer bonuses: villager exp
Leveling the E string reduces the harp power generation rate as one of its bonuses
Teach-note NPC unlocks next note when you give a few hundred of the current one; 10 notes in total
Last string strummed gets a multiplier based on how many strings you strum; each string adds 25% bonus to the last
E string does no note generation but gives more harp power per power; level it fairly early and balance with D and C
G string (melodic twine) gives experience to all strings per string; with engineer schematic and 7 strings last string gives about 380k exp
Strumming across all seven strings tuned to G could give a full level on all strings
Engineer unlock E string gives more harp power per hour; base is one experience per 100% harp power so leveling is slow
Stringy effect engineer bonus gives strings 15% more notes experience and opal chance
Domino effect gives 20% more string plucked per string to last string and doubles harp power
Author has seven strings; nine is current cap and gives 180% multiplier on last string
Measurer level 7 bonus gives harp string experience using sharp notes multiplied by total account level
Wish costs go from one to four to six then 16 quickly so it becomes very expensive
Highest measurer level seen is 10 and highest engineer level seen is 16 or 17
Wish resets conjurer points to put into idleon magic like forge capacity or multi then reset back into hole magic
1 million Opals wish gives one opal; first costs one wish then four wishes per opal
Measurer gives 74.8% more daily lamp wishes multiplied by crops found; 160 crops is max currently
Currently unlocked engineer bonuses give skill efficiency from hive and from motherload
Fractal fly in harp synergy gives 10% harp note production multiplier based on hive layers destroyed
There are four ways to boost cavern 1: two from the surface (engineer and measurer) and two from other caverns; everything in the hole interlocks.
AFK hour bonuses only affect the text fight, not the multipliers on the right side as far as he has seen.
He rethrows a poor 172k roll and wins at 110k; if he loses he gets the bonuses back tomorrow.
After the first improvement the chance drops to about 60% for the second, needing more clean resource, and failing wastes hours.
Gloomy Ludy engineer schematic gives 5% drop rate per colony of glooies defeated; 12 colonies gives 60%
Sanctum of Loot gives 20% drop rate per ancient golem sanctum cleared; about 24-25 sanctums gives almost 500%
Measurer's 16th upgrade gives a drop rate multiplier that scales with golems killed in the sanctum; 82% for him
Wisdom monument gives a drop rate multiplier based on how many times you chose player drop rate in the daily miniGame; 45% for him
Mushrooms drop a new world 5 card gloomy mushroom giving more village exp passive and can spawn crystal mobs
The Hole requires World 5; map is an alternate path off the Mr Bright side map.
Early on balance leveling C and D strings by tuning one string to C and one to D
Unlock the second bucket as soon as you can; it is a huge upgrade that doubles bucket fill rate and lets buckets use different rocks.
Upgrade this measurer bonus as much as possible fairly early since it boosts bucket fill, village exp and more; he has almost 8,000% ring and ping rate.
Explorer is probably one of the most important villagers to level up early in the hole.
20 Opals can be bought in the gem shop; not necessary but significantly speeds early progress.
When Conjurer unlocks put only a few points in; focus on Explorer or Engineer for resources.
Spend most of your early conjurer points in village magic; opal enthusiasm first.
Without King Doot spend the two conjurer points into pocket divinity as soon as you can.
Each bucket fills individually and you can select the rock per bucket; his six buckets make about 2.3-2.4 billion rocks per hour.
After the sixth measurer bonus you need lots of Brunknite ore to upgrade bucket fill rate; engineer upgrades need various ores so expect to mine other ores.
Hunting the Hounds gives bucket fill rate based on hounds killed per class in cavern 3; his kills give 151 per hour.
Motherload and Bucket Synergy gives all buckets +10% per motherload layer unlocked; at about 19-20 layers he gets a 6x multiplier.
Expander Extravaganza gives all buckets 20% more fill rate based on how many times you've expanded all rocks in the well; more expansions means a bigger bonus.
A later Better Buckets raises base from 15 to 20 per hour; the third bucket schematic gives damage based on gold dust, a side note.
Measurer level 6 gives bucket fill based on Brunknite levels, multiplied by your highest single-hit damage (see taskboard Road to Max Damage in world 2).
Mining on a character (offline or AFK) reduces a layer's ore; destroy it for one opal, then required mining efficiency rises (638 million for him).
You fight dogs for score and engineer amplifiers multiply score, but each has a penalty; some people are over a million score.
The kills run matters for the camp engineer bonus giving bucket fill per hounds defeated on best run per class; he has 400 kills on three classes and 200 on beginner.
He only risks the last-sword gamble on mobs around 10-15k HP at his damage so he can kill more waves later.
Engineer bonus Double Dinger Ringer gives rings a 30% chance of +2 levels; a gem shop investment may let you wait for the next bonus.
first_chance=100%
Don't spend too much time on motherload ore for bucket fill; other sources are much more significant; just keep unlocking layers.
Explorer needs lots of Opals early to unlock more caverns
Nine Opals give about 8-9k exp/hour but the 10th pushes to 14k; enhance opal enthusiasm to level 4
Measurer is about as important as Engineer; aim 20 Explorer
The accuracy amplifier needs a set accuracy for 100% hit chance (starts at 6K and stacks quickly); the Shaky bubble in alchemy becomes more useful.
Don't overlevel E early because unlocking the G note makes leveling much easier
Cosmos Enhance is a flat 30% village exp for 3 points; if gem shop bonuses bought
Don't spend conjurer points in idolon magic early; benefits come roughly a month after release
His base rate is about 2400 and the damage multiplier is huge (~8.56 million percent), one of the biggest bucket fill multipliers.
He knows of a measurer bonus at level 9 similar to harp note gain and level 10 multi kill.
He usually gets about 2.3x at the 24-hour mark, roughly once a day unless you use gem shop lamps to speed it up.
Author got about four opals with D string around level 20 and two or three strings tuned to D
Each bucket has a low base fill rate (~10/hr) and a resource cap; an engineering schematic later lets you expand the cap.
With expand on, a full bar eats half the resource and raises the cap (100 to 50, new cap 150), expanding each time you fill it.
Spend gravel on opals: give X gravel and get an opal, with the gravel cost rising for each next opal.
Well opals are how you generate the early opals needed to level Explorer and Engineer; he is at 12 and the next costs about 22 billion.
Engineer schematics boost bucket fill rate; Better Buckets multiplies base by 50%, 10 to 15 per hour.
Loading Some Load gives bucket fill rate based on motherload ore mined in cavern 2.
Cavern 2 motherload is the second layer to unlock and is quick; it is where you unlock the Engineer villager.
Motherload is an early opal source that slows quickly; it depends on mining efficiency, so warrior classes especially Divine Knights are best.
You blow through the first five layers fast then get maybe one or two layers per day depending on mining efficiency.
Dog Den is a wave mechanic where killing more dogs gives more score; it gives many opals early, scaling with your stats.
First engineer bonuses: about 25% more Opal exp per hour and 50% bucket fill rate early.
His ping is 584,000 per hour needing 9.2 million per opal; opals never reset when you renew the bell.
Bar Expanderorama: expanding by eating half the resource raises the total collected and the expansion bonus at the bottom.
His start: 10 Opals into Explorer
His ring gave +20% bucket fill rate; he makes 2.3 million per hour, and each ring raises the next cost, so a ring takes hours.

account_structure.say: Strengthen all characters rather than only one so World 7 progression is less difficult.
Do not reach World 7 with tools missing on neglected characters; develop the whole account rather than only one or two characters.
Avoid pushing immediately without supporting systems because the account could fall behind; prioritize Rift Slug and account development.
Create a new email to start a fresh account.
Assign fishing samples to Death Bringers and ore samples to Divine Knights or Royal Guardians.
The current ten-character meta duplicates Divine Knight and Deathbringer and Arcane Cultist with one of every other class.
The speculative final lineup has four warriors and four mages plus two archers and one Void Walker.
World Six skills help address the new damage and accuracy and defense shortages.
Use two Royal Guardians so one can specialize in production, pushing, or marble farming.
Maintain one combat Royal Guardian and one passive-bonus Royal Guardian, switching roles according to the day's needs.

account_structure.say: Raise family level from 1,357 to 1,500 to unlock character ten; the following character requires 5,000.
After unlocking character ten, another 3,500 family levels are needed to reach the 5,000 requirement for the next character.
The creator usually runs two Death Bringers and two Divine Knights and two Arcane Cultists.
Concentrate resources on one Siege Breaker and Wind Walker and Arcane Cultist and Death Bringer and Divine Knight and Elemental Sorcerer.
Voidwalker may also receive investment while remaining characters handle specialized tasks with fewer resources.
Get a free written account review from Chaos by joining his Discord, taking the account review role and requesting one; a video review can be requested too.
The creator recommends only one Bubonic Conjuror rather than two.
Consider stamp farming and pushing other characters through World Three for scarves while preparing Doot Scythe and World Six.
Picking the wrong character distribution (e.g. 10 archers or 10 warriors) can't be undone without deleting the account, and no archer means the pirate flag task is uncompletable.
Late in the game characters can't be reset via the gem shop; exalts, prismas and the new doublers can permanently break your account.
Prioritize reaching World Six because its bonuses offer major multiplicative improvements.
One extra character generally will not ruin an account.
Reviewer covers stamps alchemy equipment then bubble priority where to park characters and where to active; notes people usually just ask about drop rate

account_structure.say: He recommends upgrading both Divine Knights to Royal Guardians and doubts another Divine Knight master-class branch will arrive soon.
The demonstrated preparation strategy works for both free and paying players.
World Six improves damage and money and talents and skill efficiency and many skill speeds.
World Six skills progress through regular management rather than traditional character skill-efficiency requirements.
Players manage ten characters with idle and AFK progression.
An account has ten characters but typically uses only about three actively.
Prioritizing one or two characters for world pushing is reasonable.
Have two Divine Knights in a 10 character setup since a second DK boosts build rate by about 30 to 40%
Don't have more than one Beast Master since Siege Breaker is better in every department
Have two Blood Berserkers since the ladle production from two makes cooking two times faster
Don't have more than one Voidwalker due to the effort needed compared to the payoff
Don't have more than one Bubonic Conjuror since it must be actively played to perform
Safe 10-man build A: one Beast Master and one Siege Breaker and two each of Divine Knight and Blood Berserker and Elemental Sorcerer plus one Bubonic and one Voidwalker
Safe 10-man build B: one Beast Master and two Siege Breakers and two Divine Knights and one Blood Berserker and two Elemental Sorcerers plus one Bubonic and one Voidwalker
Invest less in duplicate classes while developing one main character of each class.

Pulse Mage is single target with high attack speed but low damage.
Fireball Lobber shoots exploding fireballs hitting multiple enemies in a small radius; slower attack but more damage.
Boulder Roller is one of the highest damaging towers; hits multiple enemies down the lane but attacks very slowly.
Frozone Malone casts a freezing wave slowing all enemies hit; stacks with other frozen towers; casts slowly and does no damage.
Stormcaller is single target with the highest single-target damage but attacks super slowly.
Party Starter is a buff tower that does no damage and has no function until level 5.
Kraken Cosplay summons Eyeball Defenders that knock enemies back slowly so other towers deal more damage.
Wave display shows current wave and seconds until the next wave spawns.
You always start each mini-game with 5 HP.
You lose 1 HP each time a monster reaches the totem.
A monster reaching the totem is sent back to the portal and restarts its path without regenerating HP.
Points are mini-game currency gained from kills and at wave completion; spent on summoning or upgrading towers.
This Wave and Next Wave show enemies left and each enemy's HP.
Next Wave button summons the next wave instantly and awards bonus points.
Summoning a tower increases the cost of all subsequent towers even of a different type.
Trash button deletes towers currently on the map.
Forfeit ends the mini-game early; you are still rewarded based on your current level.
At tower level 5 you select one of two upgrade paths.
Pulse Mage paths: chance to multi-hit or pushback on non-boss monsters.
Fireball Lobber paths: chance to throw multiple fireballs or larger explosion radius.
Boulder Roller paths: boulders travel 30 percent farther or hit two more enemies.
Frozone Malone paths: stronger slow or monsters stay frozen two seconds longer.
Stormcaller paths: extra damage to enemies below 50% HP or all towers in range gain 5% crit chance.
Party Starter does nothing until a path is chosen: towers in range get 25% attack speed or kills in range give 10% more points.
Kraken Cosplayer paths: plus 1 max Underling or Underlings push mobs back 25% farther.
There are 4 enemy types with different speed and health and 6 colors giving special buffs.
Zoomo enemies have high speed but low health.
Normos have average speed and health; Largos low speed and high health; Gigaos are boss mobs spawning only in boss waves with very low speed and very high health.
Gray is normal; green mobs heal continuously below 50% HP.
Red mobs heal nearby monsters when killed; blue mobs go invincible briefly after 5 hits; orange explode on death stunning towers; purple teleport when hit.
Wizard gets the most Worship buffs but being a Wizard in the mini-game doesn't affect highest wave or mini-game rewards.
Maestro's Indiana Attack hits multiple enemies or pulls them back toward the character.
Hunter's Stop Right There summons bear traps and roots all enemies; longer at higher skill level.
Hunter's Kung Fu Kick is also a knockback.
Wizard is the only character getting direct Worship benefits from its talents.
Worship Efficiency scales directly from Wisdom.
Worship Efficiency and highest wave completed together determine XP and souls gained per Worship click.
Skull gives more Worship Power and increases Maximum Charge.
Wis Wumbo increases the max talent level of Book of the Wise.
Occult Obols give more Wisdom from your Obols.
AFK gain rates don't really affect anything in Worship.
Mage is Best multiplies all passive bonuses from the small purple bubbles.
Prayer Obelisk is the last major efficiency increase and a major Worship reward besides souls.
His next prayer needs wave 81 of the Goblin Gorfest Worship totem.
Each prayer has a major benefit and a curse penalty; prayers can be upgraded by spending souls.
Each upgrade level raises the benefit and also the curse penalty.
You gain talent points for each Worship level gained on each character.
Early game focus on Boulder Roller Party Starters Frozen Balloon and Storm Collars when unlocked as essential to level
Worship box gives Worship Efficiency, Max Charge and starting points in Worship Tower Defense
Should start farming worship charging and buy all skulls out and get cogs rolling
World 3 has three skills to tackle: worship trapping and construction
Wakawaka War is the level 10 totem used in Worship.
Totem provides Dune Souls whenever you spend Worship Charge or complete Tower Defense waves.
Damage is capped at 1 per hit in Tower Defense so you do not need to spec into all damage talents.
Pushing back enemies helps the Kraken Tower keep enemies in line.
Turn on auto attack in early waves since you can do enough damage to kill some early mobs.
Next goal is 2 more Poisonic Elders as quickly as possible plus a Stormcaller between the Poisonic Elders and the Kraken.
Place the Stormcaller then the Kraken again when you have enough points to replace both; most effective setup though you lose some points.
Next phase: 2 more Kraken towers at end of the line close together and another Stormcaller as the last tower.
Depending on Poisonic Elder base level it may be worth upgrading towers instead of getting the last tower out.
Upgrade the middle Poisonic Elders first as primary damage dealers; they get stunned frequently early.
Upgrade Poisonic Elders to level 5 and take Trait B as fast as possible for more damage.
Worship's primary stats are Worship Efficiency
Totem menu shows current totem
Summon opens a portal; enemies walk down the platform
In the mini-game each character attack does only one damage regardless of gear
Myriad crate gives base all efficiency and stats but needs a ridiculous amount of boxes so not an early game priority
In World 3 the Isaccian Shrine gives more HP and Defense; slow to level but percentage based
Crits deal 2x damage so more Crit Chance equals more damage.
Next Wave Button gives additional points but stunned Voidinator can't handle purple mobs.
Rest of game is upgrading towers and placing 3 additional Party Starters; costs get exorbitant.
Trait A allows multiple clouds out at once per tower so mobs take damage the entire time in range.
Second Stormcaller level 10 gives middle tower about 80% crit; all but last tower have 80% crit roughly doubling damage.
Extra slow keeps Kraken towers efficient longer; duration doesn't matter since it attacks fast.
Salt Lick page 2 gives more Tower Defense points from killing monsters.
Completing World 3 Fat Souls achievement gives more starting points in Worship Tower Defense.
You may need to replace your Kraken tower depending on its placement so the full setup sits between portal and first Kraken.
Not a concern in early waves but a few waves later there will be 7 or 8 teleporting mobs.
Keep killing mobs actively in early waves or your tower takes avoidable damage.
Worship is a World 3 skill; you use charge at a totem or the easy access totem from construction.

Can drop balloons while standing next to a worship totem without starting summon
Building Death Note requires Orange Salts from the Refinery and Forest Souls from Worship

Place Stormcaller butted up close to the others; delete the Kraken between waves to save space and place new towers quickly.
If struggling at this stage do upgrades first.
Keep upgrading all 3 Poisonic Elders with Trait B for more Cloud Hit Chance; gives base damage and more ticks.
Souls from worship are needed for practically everything from crafting to upgrades
Wizards are best at worship due to Charge Siphon which steals charge from all other characters for use on the wizard

Automation arm gives easy automation totem which gains souls from any place with wave of 10 or higher
After the basic setup, focus on leveling towers and placing Party Towers, leveling each individually as you add more.
Place only one Party Tower at a time and get it to level 5 quickly before placing the next, since they do nothing until level 5.
Level new Party Towers to level 5 as quickly as possible since that is when you get benefits.
Then wait on points to summon more Party Defense Towers.
Keep mobs in check with your abilities by rooting them or attacking yourself.
Next priority is getting Party Towers out
Complete the first 4 quests from Hoggindaz to unlock Worship.
Completing wave 10 of Forest Outskirts Totem unlocks Big Brain Time; each tier unlocks more prayers.
Pulse Mage is single target; A trait gives 25% multi-hit chance and B trait pushes enemies back 5 pixels.
Fire Lobber is first AOE tower; A trait 15% chance to shoot two fireballs; B trait increases explosion radius 20%.
All towers are in range of the Party Starters except farther ones which may not fully reach Stormcaller.
Stormcaller can add 20% crit on the middle tower and reach a third tower for up to 100% crit between both Stormcallers.
With both Stormcallers a tower has about 40% crit chance giving about 30% more damage overall.
Slow lets Poison towers deal more damage and relieves Kraken towers.

After wave 10 with enough points summon Kraken Defense Tower then a Party Tower at the top beside the rope.

Using charge siphon only gives XP to your wizard

Skip upgrading the Kraken Tower early since it's expensive and generally not worth it.
Knockback is helpful for keeping mobs near your towers longer
Click the totem then press Summon Button to start Tower Defense and menus pop up
First towers to summon are Fireball Towers and Frost Towers
In early waves you may need to shoot some enemies yourself; don't worry about it too much
With spare points place a few more fireball towers at the bottom to catch anything that gets past

Next priority is Kraken Tower which keeps enemies under towers longer
Place 2 more Fireball Towers at the bottom
Upgrading top towers priority is Fireball Towers first
On Fireball Towers always take Trait B 20% bigger explosion radius first then Trait A

Finally add more Party Towers and upgrade all towers to level 10
Use Roots and Knockbacks as often as possible to keep monsters in tower range longer

Spec into Stop Right There talent which immobilizes nearby monsters; higher level gives longer root
Spec into 360 NoScope talent because it can hit multiple enemies
Take Kung Fu Kick in tab 2; it pushes back nearby monsters and higher level pushes farther
Level Piercing Arrow enough to hit all 4 monsters since it hits multiple enemies
Choose trait Other towers in range get more speed for Party Tower; the other trait is not working currently
A fifth totem is being added in World 4 but was unavailable at the time of recording.
Party Tower does nothing until level 5 so level it ASAP
Don't spend points on Party Tower if you won't take it to level 5
Later waves are overwhelming so keep upgrading towers especially primary attackers and Party Towers for damage and attack speed
Purple mobs teleport every time they are hit; Krakens must knock them back into Voidinator range or they skip past and damage HP.
Stormcaller towers mainly give more Crit Chance so they are not important early game.
Second row buildings are the Worship Tower Defense towers; each level raises tower damage and lowers upgrade cost in the minigame.
Slush Skull is a low level Worship Skull slightly better than the crafted version.
Fourth totem is in the Rolling Tundra and is accessible at level 45.
The initial tower setup should get you easily through about wave 10.
Party Tower level 5 gives a 25% speed bonus.
Using root and attacks yourself helps get through early waves a lot faster.
Damage is distributed better with more towers early game
Tachion of the Titans worship bonus allows giant mobs to spawn after killing some mobs.
Acorn Assault is the level 30 Worship totem located in World 1 map The Roots.

Totem gives Forest Souls when you spend Worship Charge or complete Tower Defense waves

arcade.say: Usually wait for a gold-bar multiplier before spending arcade balls.
Kingdom resources and Prisma bonuses are good; fountain speed is useful and research XP is a must.
Deathbringer bone bonuses are useful for its masterclass resource.
New-crown bonuses are useful for a later mechanic but the account is still far away.
Multikill per tier is a strong arcade-shop bonus.
Emperor bonuses and sneaking multiplier and summoning experience are worthwhile arcade choices.
Reindeer is worthwhile with strong arcade progression but not with a weak arcade.
Resource is very limited, so hold onto the balls as much as possible.
Marble drop rate omega is really good since marble drop rate is the current meta; Lumi gains is a shoe-in.
Definitely Lumi and Marble, maybe Golden Ball and Class, probably not Artifact, super maybe Croc; strong buffs in the Golden Ball shop.
Multi kill is top tier stat; extra 40% per tier is worth an Omega.
Research EXP multiplier is the best Omega pick; slightly ahead of multi-kill and cooking speed.
Drop rate extra 120% is a maybe for Omega; consider if near endgame with sources pushed; otherwise save; his gain about 5000.
Always prioritize Burger as an exceptionally strong arcade bonus.
Tome loves arcade upgrade scores; spread balls evenly to stretch them and avoid future Tome problems.
Arcade is a monstrous Lumi increase; supered then omegaed gives 3.4x true multiplier
Don't overlook the big multipliers especially the second upgrade and arcade; they push you a long way
Most players should avoid Cosmic Balls because they will not benefit enough.
Omega priority: cooking speed multi
Remaining Supers and gold ball options are only all right.
Plinko gives chance at gold balls spent in the arcade shop; wait for the rotation which increases golden ball values before spending.
Class EXP is the worst option since it is so small.
Grab the new arcade node giving extra blood cells (10%); unsure if true multi
Kingdom-resource bonuses apply to Royal Guard's system.
The arcade Prisma bonus affects Prisma bubbles.
Fountain speed applies to the World 5 hole mechanic.
Research is a World 7 mechanic.
Get obol fragments by recycling obols or from the arcade; amount received depends on the obol's rarity.
Tab one talent points is S tier and god tier; you need it any time of year.
Worship soul % is S tier; the bottom of S and better than critters.
Refinery % speed is easy S tier with no competition; anything increasing salt production is massive.
Drop rate % is the best stat in the game and should be the first one maxed.
If you have maxed S and A tier and are working on B tier you are a whale because it takes huge golden balls or jackpots.
Jade gain % is bottom S or top A and fantastic; sneaking never ends so speeding it up is a big win.
Villager XP multi is multiplicative and unbelievably strong for the hole.
Gold ball gain % is SS tier and should be maxed first because it halves the cost of every other investment.
Placement varies by game stage; if you only did S tier you would be happy and S and A are all good.
Don't buy the Spirit Reindeer pack unless your arcade is juiced; it's strong on paper only if already deep into the upgrades.
Killroy candy rewards are strong but weaker than the previously powerful arcade balls.
Slime increases arcade golden-ball earnings by 25%.
Spirit Reindeer doubles gold-ball shop bonuses.
Hedgehog grants 200% golden-ball gains.
Sample size % is only useful if trying to drop the Royal Sampler prayer; that is an overly endgame standpoint.
Arcade shop now shows whether a bonus is multiplicative
Artifact rotation bonuses and menagerie research boost are not the reason; AI answer was wrong.
Forge capacity is S tier and worth maxing and doubling; new worlds bars and level 13 God Shard and Dreadlo vials need more.
He uses arcade balls during the limited-time 1.25-times golden-ball bonus.
Anything in A or S tier will not disappoint.
Reindeer supports what he calls the game's highest burger percentage.
Arcade gold coin and luster coin give money percent but are hard to scale so never a huge priority.
New Omega arcade upgrades give additional 3x that stacks with Super 2x and cost two Omega balls each earned from Menagerie
You need 2100 account level for Lab to get the last jewels so lab XP is mildly useful late.
Dungeon bundle contents: 20 boosted runs; 250 arcade balls; three dungeon card packs; 4000 gems; $20
Arcade balls for arcade omega are farmed like prisma fragments from arcane cultist; one-in chance scales aggressively with no way to reduce it yet.
The crossover rewards gems and arcade balls.
Collect arcade balls every day to avoid capping so you can spend them toward the red hat
Do Killroy and arcade.
Spend accumulated arcade balls.
Arcade frag rewards are obol fragments.
Cosmic balls only come from events so don't worry about them.
Loot value and nugget regen belong in the same spot because neither is needed once boats are leveled or the nugget is complete.
Current shop rotation is 74 and changes every four to six weeks; he thinks it should be weekly; covered in weekly video.
Trapping levels are a punishment even with nature traps prayer of proficiency and transfusion so trapping XP is worth getting.
Weapon power is better than base damage; F and C tier picks are marginal could-or-couldn't choices.
Skill XP is not as good as trapping XP but feeds into trapping.
Spending 32000 golden balls on base defense is poor when about five plat on a stamp gives the same; better than base damage but worse than weapon power.
Critters matter for Refinery scorpions and level 13 vials; top of A tier.
Pet damage is available from Beast Master talents and cooking so it is placed below shiny critter % and catching XP.
Villager XP is below refinery speed and drop rate but above forge cap since forge cap is obtainable in the hole; should be second or third max.
Fishing XP % is placed above mining XP and argued to be the best of the three XP types.
AFK gain is only 2% for 32000 balls, and a badly rolled keychain gives more.
Liquid cap bonus is placed in front of starting worship defense; either spot is fine.
Multi-kill per tier is bottom S or top A; debate whether jade or souls goes above it.
Stamps reducing plinko cost are horribly rare; 0.1% chance on a golden bucket; some long-time players have one.
Using daily arcade balls in World 2 town can easily give up to 10 gems per day.
B C and F tier may vary slightly depending on early mid late or end game.
Arcade golden ball shop rotation sells weapon power and base damage so save golden balls if you want more dps
Play Singed cards via the king card in W1 town; main prize cosmic balls are spent in the arcade to boost max level of gold ball shop upgrades by 2 extra.
Skeleton keys give 2,200 gold balls on average on the gold ball drop table, mainly due to the huge 64,000 top prize; median is lower.
Missing 3.4x vs 2.2x on omega'd Lumi gains in arcade likely means missing the reindeer pet which increases arcade bonuses.
Cosmic balls from the winter event double an arcade bonus if it is already maxed with golden balls.
Maxing a single arcade upgrade takes about 32000 golden balls without the stamp that reduces golden ball cost.
Trapping critter % gives more critters without extra efficiency but does not scale up shinies.
Drop rate helps rare mob farming and multi-kill farming for base materials.
Using the arcade to farm accuracy percent.

Left tilt wins more often but not as big.
Worship soul % helps ignore a lot of Tower Defense in Frosty Firefight and helps get breezy souls in World 6 and prayers.
More caverns are guaranteed (about 15 or more) plus more villagers so villager XP will stay important.
Double check arcade shop for AFK gain rate or stat bonuses that help sampling.
Older additive options are eclipsed by new multipliers; only consider if early and flush with golden balls; otherwise skip rotation.
Maestro family bonus gives sample size the more he levels up.
Arcade golden balls bonus in rotation gives a sample size option for purchase.
Free-to-play players without No Meal Left Behind should treat it as heavy A; with NMLB it matters only around cooking level 70s.
Creator thinks accuracy is higher than 3D printer power of 10 turkeys; argues accuracy matters until mid World 6.
Check the shop and have enough currency for the statue item; stockpile statues until they can be unlocked for everyone.
Bob Joe Pickle needs to be bought every day; the NPC moved to avoid confusion.
The arcade has a drop rate bonus that can be maxed at 15%.
He upgrades arcade construction speed to around 16% because it helps immediately.
Arcade shop sometimes has a drop rate bonus of 15% base or up to 30% doubled
Arcade gives small benefits like AFK gain rates multi-kill per tier and base damage

Do mini-games every day since they are among the fastest ways to level a skill and gain quick resources.

spelunking.say: Work on older upgrades while waiting for spelunking stamina and other World Seven time gates.
With ample stamina run the first spelunking map deeply using stamina potions and rotate three-character groups for snail mail.
Spelunking offers the account's largest immediate POW progression gains.
Hard-focus the Warhammer upgrade tab.
Elixirs are the next major source of progression after Warhammer upgrades.
Focus lore discoveries because they strongly improve early POW and amber generation.
Amber on the Brain is a useful early upgrade.
Click and hold an elixir to memorize it and obtain its perk immediately at the start.
Extra stamina supports discoveries and boss progression and deeper runs and amber farming so ranks above Killroy.
The skill-experience multiplier helps reach very high spelunking levels.
Use full Nova potions while initially leveling Manic Mode, spending stamina first and then gaining four free waves per potion.
Do not spend all stamina on snail-mail farming before its unlock; prioritize POW and amber upgrades first.
Run Spelunking item runs to replenish the lanterns needed for monument rewards.
After lucky blue procs, he expects this run to finish around floors 410–430, possibly farther with luck.
Send only five or six characters when final-object limits will end the run anyway, preserving others for another cave.
Finish the remaining three caverns before repeating this run for a possible forty extra depths.
For snail mail, choose a normal Meadow run rather than a shortcut and descend as deeply as possible.

More spelunking levels before statue week make sense to increase stamina available for spending orange potions.
Enabling Manic Mode consumes substantial stamina.
Grand Discoveries matters later but is not an immediate target for this account.
Improve best hauls across spelunking depths because their combined records provide valuable bonuses.
Push the first three manic caves; depth five hundred is achievable and supplies additional shells.
Use three purple elixirs, one blue, and one yellow in Meadow to conserve stamina.
Most players should send three or four characters for a few dozen snail mail; higher stamina can reduce the required roster.
Do not enable full-clear Spelunking yet.
The lore path is not bad since spelunking power and amber are good, but Gospel should be pushed much deeper.
Get onto No Escape right now, since Piece of Pages has been fixed and it is super easy to get all the No Escape needed.
The account badly needs extra chapter levels.
Getting multiple hits on the final No Escape line and doing it daily for about a month will fix the lore.
Amber is the next thing to fix, and looking at the bosses shows the problem.
Do a Final Cavern run right now, which could boost daily amber gains by 5-6x, probably nearer 10x.
The account is in the perfect spot to do a Final Cavern run right now.
Punch out at depth 410 to be on the safer side.
Burn stamina at around depth 350 and then punch out at 410.

Legend talent that never loses over stim from starting spelunking dungeons; he will buy it right after the video.

Construction is split into a Building tab and a Cogs tab.
Three categories of buildings; each needs a different material and can be leveled several times to raise its bonuses.
Each building level raises the resource cost of the next level.
3D Printer prints resources for each unlocked character; each level lets one more character use it.
Library building raises max talent level by spending books; each level raises checkout refresh speed so you get books faster.
Death Note building gives +2% multi-kill to all worlds per level.
Salt Lick building has 10 upgrades; each building level unlocks another bonus.
Chest Space building gives two extra storage chest slots per level.
Cost Cruncher cuts building upgrade resource cost 1% per level; it does not affect the initial build but is a big bonus.
Trapper Drone deploys and collects traps remotely; each level gives extra critters from all traps.
Automation Arm has five bonuses that help with tedious tasks; each level unlocks another. The last building is not yet available.
Second row buildings are the Worship Tower Defense towers; each level raises tower damage and lowers upgrade cost in the minigame.
Shrines give a bonus only while placed on a map your characters are on.
Second shrine leveling method is placing the shrine on the map where a character AFKs; each shrine needs a set number of AFK hours active.
Woodular Shrine increases total damage of all characters on the same map.
Isaccian Shrine increases max HP and total defense.
Crystal Shrine increases level-up rate for all your other shrines.
Pantheon Shrine increases carry capacity of all characters on that map.
Clover Shrine increases drop rate of all characters.
Summer Reading Shrine increases EXP gain for all characters.
Crescent Shrine increases spawn chance of crystal and giant mobs while active.
Undead Shrine increases monster respawn rate on that map.
Primordial Shrine boosts AFK gain rate for characters on the same map up to a max of 150%.
Total Build Rate shown at the bottom comes from the Cogs tab.
Total build rate applies to each active building slot individually; his gives 176000 per hour per slot.
Character bars on the right show each character's construction level and build rate per hour; mostly used in the Cogs tab.
Open Cog Shelf builds new cogs; initially only Newbie Cogs are available and need construction level 1.
Each cog stored on the shelf doubles the cost of building the next cog.
At construction level 15 a character can be assigned to the next cog tier if above the level requirement.
Collected cogs go automatically to storage; collection is very random including graphic variants like Broken Cog.
Special cogs boost adjacent cogs or have other bonuses listed below a dotted line.
Number of stats varies per cog; an Ultimate cog does not necessarily have more stats than a Super cog.
Adjacent Cog is plus-shaped and boosts the four touching cogs; example gives 29% build rate.
Diagonal Cog works like Adjacent but applies to the four diagonal corners; its bonus type varies.
Arrow Cogs apply to six slots directly facing the arrow direction.
Column Cogs apply bonuses to a full column; bonus types can match other cogs.
Row Cog works like Column Cog but applies across a full row.
Omnidirectional Cog acts like Diagonal but applies one additional diagonal space further out.
Tap Me button switches which of three stats is displayed on cogs on the board and in storage.
Flags Place button lets you place up to four flags to unlock board squares; stored flag rate is saved when moving a flag.
Initially only the center of the board is unlocked; flags are needed to expand it.
Flaggy points needed to unlock a square increase the farther it is from the center; it requires an obscene amount.
Characters provide most of his flaggy rate compared to the low numbers on cogs.
Trash Cogs button is a toggle that deletes any clicked cog.
Carpenter bubble gives build speed per construction level; great for center characters surrounded by facing cogs.
Visible Ink vial gives construction EXP.
Sippy Cup vial increases cog production speed.
Bubonic Burp vial from bunnies gives extra cog inventory spaces; he hasn't unlocked it.
Chizoar card is passive and doesn't need to be equipped.
Redox Rates talent increases build speed based on Redox Salts in your storage chest.
Sharper Saws squire talent gives extra construction EXP gain.
Gem shop has four construction upgrades under World 3 bonuses.
Zen Cogs boost all surrounding cogs by 40% build rate and flaggy rate; expensive but a pretty good boost.
Tower Building Slots lets you build up to four additional construction buildings simultaneously.
Fluorescent Flaggies boost flaggy rate 50% per upgrade for 300% more flaggy speed total.

kangaroo.say: Before resetting stockpile plenty of Roo fish to maximize Crossover.

Collect shinies whenever available while upgrading and obtain at least one of each type to stack multipliers.

Get all six fish multipliers running and buy as many Fishing Buddy levels as possible.

The final Megafish stage begins repeatable bonus stacking like Fractal Feathers.

royal_armory.say: Assign the initial ability, open Royal Armory, acquire the resource tool, collect wheat, and build an outpost on the frog map.
Find marble in each world with Royal Guardian and spend it attempting statue unlocks that grant account-wide bonuses.
Ignore the Orblet shop at this early stage because the account cannot meaningfully access it.
Unlock additional kingdom worlds through shelves in the upgrade tree.
Defeat enough monsters on a map to create an outpost that houses units.
Prioritize barracks capacity because more units allow greater flexibility in unit composition.
Drag a line from an outpost to a resource and collect until that resource is depleted.
Deplete resources to upgrade their ranks; switch traders to farmers when trying to finish depletion quickly.
Use militia to conquer maps without monsters, such as mines, because they cannot be captured through active kills.

Prioritize Bargain, then Talented, because upgrade cost and talent points are the hardest progression resources.
Reserve outpost points for barracks, then use traders to maximize trading ranks.
Focus Bargain for maximum discount and talent upgrades for more points.
Continue upgrades until resource ranks unlock and change progression.
Place militia either on the map being actively pushed or on maps without monsters.
Empty every resource to maximize available upgrades promptly.

Preset harder resource nodes for tomorrow and manually handle easy ones after the daily reset.
Hold unnecessary upgrade points in reserve in case the next update makes them useful.

Royal Guardian's system is active.

Push with War Bound Politics during supervised daytime play so completed outposts can be built and the character moved onward.

Royal Guardian has separate progression like Wind Walker or Death Bringer but does not require changing form.

Glorifying every map is not worthwhile yet; Wood Mushrooms might justify it because its large resource needs substantial collection rate.
Item costs are the major bottleneck, so reduce master-class costs quickly, beginning with Orblet Bargain.

Long-term progression is to have three dudes on your outpost

If you have access to iOS make all purchases there as it gives a massive leg up on other players
Meta is saving points for more guys: third on pixel range giving 25 and other two on working the node or trading experience

sushi.say: The sushi strategy obtains high tiers without excessive spending.

Continue the cascade until the last tier-27 sushi to finish the rotation.

Double-clicking sushi can interrupt the cascade; take time and let animations finish.
